name: Landscape Specimen
tagline: A landscape plate per item with the name set giant in the sky as a two-font specimen, masthead row, BACK/NEXT nav.
whenToUse: Top-N tools, plugins and repos listicles (spine C), one item per landscape
production: hybrid: a text-free Codex landscape plate per slide, fitted by composite.py; this overlay sets every word and all chrome

layouts.cover: cover set (Inter Black kicker, Playfair Display Black Italic hero, Inter Bold outcome) in 12-43%
layouts.item: kicker, giant name, caption, use line, proof line in 12-52%
layouts.stake: P3 giant number or two-word stake, kicker, caption in 12-52%
layouts.proof: full stack in 11-44% (giant and caption one line), capture card on the horizon (46-88%)
layouts.combo: kicker = tool A, giant = tool B, one-line caption flanked by two real app icons, use line
layouts.cta: kicker 'comment' (Playfair italic), keyword in P3 caps (6 chars) else P2 caps, caption

pairings.P1: Playfair Display Italic 400 over Inter Black (-0.05em, own case), 10 characters
pairings.P2: Instrument Serif 400 over Archivo wdth 62 wght 900 italic, 12 characters
pairings.P3: Inter Medium over Archivo wdth 125 wght 900, 6 characters or two short words on two lines

fonts: Google Fonts: Playfair Display (italic 400, 900), Instrument Serif, Archivo (variable wdth 62-125, italics), Inter, JetBrains Mono

palette.ink: #0E0E0E or #FFFFFF, whichever clears WCAG contrast on the plate (shared/sky-tone.mjs)
palette.accent: #D9551F orange: the nav pill only (ink bold number on it)

dataFlow: One copy of overlay.html per slide as <deck>/cards/slide-NN.html ({{BRAND}} filled in); edit only its slide-data JSON. sky-tone.mjs stamps tone onto <body> data attributes.

files.overlay.html: copy per slide to <deck>/cards/slide-NN.html, edit the slide-data JSON
files.preview.png: cover / item / proof / CTA over the sample plates
files.samples/: stand-in test plates (plates/), sample renders of every layout, slides.sample.json with their data

exportNaming: copy final/slide-NN.png to exports/slide-NN-YYYY-MM-DD.png (date from the deck folder name)
